messages:
Maya: Quick sync — PMs ask whether tenant SSO (customer pilot) must be in MVP or can be moved to v1. Need a gating decision today so we can lock the release runway. @andrew @sam
Andrew: My vote: push SSO to v1. It introduces infra and security work that risks the ship. We can demo with a stub for the customer if needed.
Sam: +1. Full SAML/SAML metadata exchange, cert rotation, and e2e are non-trivial. Also privacy/legal want a deeper review.
Lucy: If we take it out of MVP, what's the minimal surface we keep for the pilot? Is a login stub + account connect enough for the customer demo?
Chris: Proposal for gating checklist (draft):
```
- QA: smoke + regression on login flows
- e2e: identity provider stub coverage (happy/unhappy paths)
- Telemetry: auth.success and auth.failure events instrumented
- Feature flag: tenant.sso_enabled behind FF+rollout
- Rollback: documented ops steps to disable SSO flag within 5 minutes
- Security: threat model update + brief review by security team
```
Andrew: Also add capacity/route gating — Dedicated pools need 2x expected concurrency if real IdPs are used. Ops must sign off.
Sam: Timeline tradeoff: keep SSO out of MVP -> freeze features Tue, canary next week. Include SSO -> +2 weeks to release and squeeze several QA cycles.
Maya: Decision (log): Move tenant SSO to v1. Action items: @lucy draft the acceptance criteria and a stripped-down demo stub for MVP, @andrew create an ops fallback/runbook and capacity note, @sam schedule the privacy/security checkpoint. We'll ship a demo-level stub in MVP (feature-flagged, no production IdP) so Sales can run the pilot.
Lucy: On it — I'll open a PR with the acceptance checklist and sample config for the stub (idp-stub).
Deploy-bot: deploy queued: staging -> canary at 1748556850 :rocket:
Sam: Reminder to instrument telemetry before canary — we need the auth metrics to validate the stub path.
Andrew: Ack — adding telemetry events + a shim so we can validate in staging.
Maya: Thanks all. I'll update the release note and tell the pilot customer the change (minimal demo on MVP; full SSO in v1). :thumbsup:
